usedFor: Shopify holds your store checkouts, and OneHash Chat receives the shopper as a contact through “Create a Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create a Contact” in OneHash Chat
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who leaves a checkout becomes a chat contact you can follow up with.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the contact is created after a scheduled check.
